environment.cacheDefinition: After-seed follows insertion/index preparation; warm adds an audit; mongo-cold restarts only the disposable mongod before each phase to clear its WiredTiger cache. No OS cache eviction is performed.

limitations: Only actual repair audit/plan/verify database paths execute; no Discord requests, permission discovery, history fetch, reaction membership fetch, worker inbox or shutdown drain are measured.
Reaction-heavy data measures BSON/repair costs, not normal/burst REST completeness.
Many-threads data changes synthetic channel cardinality; permission discovery is not measured.
Node and disposable mongod CPU/RSS are separate process samples; other services and whole-host load are not attributed. Sampling can miss short peaks.
BSON bytes estimate logical command/reply payloads, not wire bytes; instrumentation overhead is included.
No OS cache eviction occurs. Synthetic indexed-sort execution stats do not describe every repair aggregation; journal command latency includes but does not isolate filesystem fsync latency.

report.scope: Real history executor and scheduler against synthetic single shared REST transport and page writer; fixed pages, request/write delays, optional 200 requests/s global ceiling. No Discord or real database. Prefetch false is the sequential-page comparison.
Synthetic four independent resource buckets with one request each, 10ms service; optional observed local wait. No real HTTP 429 or Discord traffic.
Synthetic normalization/content hash/BSON hash; owner encoding and worker round trips included, startup separately reported. No Discord, DB writes or bot credentials.

100000 synthetic normalized messages, identical snapshot collection and event-loop yields, actual notifier and English renderer plus isolated Mongo majority/journaled progress writes, 5s cadence over 50s logical clock; first pair warmup excluded. Mock transport encodes payload only; no Discord latency claim.
